pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/features/scraper/useScrapeForm.ts:230 the preview-proven refusal for an armed scrape lives only in the editor hook; src-tauri/engine/src/scraper.rs:528 config_save defaults enabled to true and :539 schedules it with no preview evidence, so any other caller arms an unproven selector on cron

techniques.evidence: src/features/scraper/useScrapeForm.ts:230 the only rung is the client; the binding door src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/scraper.rs:53 calls config_save without the check, so the client rung is a courtesy with no backstop
src-tauri/engine/src/scraper.rs:528 an omitted enabled field resolves to armed (unwrap_or(true)), so the absent value takes the permissive branch the editor gate exists to refuse

pairs.registryProposal: Runtime product gates (a UI check guarding a server write door) recur as the deviation shape in this repo (scraper, templates-recipes, notepad-plan, agents-editor): gate-laddering states the binding-rung invariant for CI pipelines only; a technique or application naming 'the refusal belongs at the write door, the renderer copy is a projection' would let judges cite it directly instead of by analogy.

pairs.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_recipes/components/RecipeDetailPanel.tsx:50 adopt is gated by a slug-only evaluator over all of CONNECTOR_META (useEligibility.ts:17), and libs/useAdoption.ts:62 writes the use case via mutateUseCases without ever reaching the backend refusal at src-tauri/src/commands/recipes/recipe_adoption.rs:86, so recipes the tool-catalog gate calls Incompatible are adopted

techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_recipes/useEligibility.ts:17 the surface re-derives eligibility from connector slugs instead of rendering the backend policy (tool_hints catalog, src-tauri/engine/src/recipe_eligibility.rs), so it advertises a different, weaker policy than the one enforced
src/features/templates/sub_recipes/libs/useAdoption.ts:62 the write path bypasses recipe_adoption.rs:86 entirely; the only refusal on the path the user takes is the client projection

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/credentials/credential_design.rs:280 a hole in the gate's own vision (network failure) and the skip at :181 (no reliable endpoint) both reach the verdict as failed, never as an announced unreachable/unverifiable; the IPC-throw path was fixed (useCredentialHealth.ts:168) but this in-band path was not
